note: Every coordinate states its origin. 'verified' = an OpenStreetMap feature with a named id (lookup 2026-11-11). 'approx' = a street rather than a point, or an unconfirmed name match; do not present as precise. OSM data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL: credit it in the footer. The dossier names only five of the closed metro stations (5 → 16 → 17 → 18 in July); the other 13 are unnamed.
base_map_status: missing: no GeoJSON/SVG base map exists in the repo. See GAPS.md.

sites.name: Jantar Mantar Road
sites.coord_origin: OpenStreetMap way 1493039594 'Jantar Mantar Protest Site' (amenity=events_venue), centre point, Overpass/Nominatim lookup 2026-11-11 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Cross-check: the derived point from docs/archive/within-earshot.md (centre of the demonstration band) is about 27 m away. Road = OSM way 24583495.
sites.role_in_story: Main protest and sit-in site, 6 Jun – 25 Jul.
sites.note: The protest street, not the observatory. The dossier: 'Jantar Mantar Road is about 1 km from Parliament House.'

sites.name: Jantar Mantar (observatory)
sites.coord_origin: OSM Nominatim point for way 223456559, per docs/archive/within-earshot.md section 4 (0 m from Nominatim, 23 m from Wikipedia's coordinate).
sites.note: Map anchor only. Not the protest location.

sites.name: Parliament House (new)
sites.coord_origin: OpenStreetMap relation 12737019 'New Parliament House', Overpass/Nominatim lookup 2026-11-11 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). The Old Parliament House is relation 6087635 (28.61719, 77.20819).
sites.role_in_story: Destination of the 20 Jul 'Sansad Chalo' march.
sites.note: The dossier doesn't say which building the march targeted; the Monsoon Session sits in the new building (assumption, check).

sites.name: Parliament Street (Sansad Marg)
sites.coord_origin: OpenStreetMap way 24583327 'Sansad Marg', centre of the segment between Jantar Mantar Road and Patel Chowk, Overpass/Nominatim lookup 2026-11-11 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). A street, not a point; the exact flashpoint position isn't recorded.
sites.role_in_story: 20 Jul: lathi charges and tear gas. PS Parliament Street registered FIR 128/26 on 13 Oct.
